_doc: Lesson battles (KAMPF_PLAN_1000 items 559, 812): fixed puzzle positions like data/puzzles.json, taught by a beaten Wayfarer whose map entry names the group in "lessons". Same fields as a Trial plus "teacher". scripts/battle/BattlePuzzle.gd.

lessons.name: Lesson: Matchups
lessons.text: Puddlet against Kindlop. Tide beats Ember: pick the art that hits hard.
lessons.hint_1: Look at the element of each art. Tide washes out Ember.

lessons.name: Lesson: Rest
lessons.text: Shalebat starts with no Energy to spare. Rest once, then strike.
lessons.hint_1: Dusk Rake costs 3 Energy. Resting gives some back.
lessons.hint_2: Rest on the first turn, then Dusk Rake.

lessons.name: Lesson: Overcharge
lessons.text: Zippit knows Overcharge: every spare Energy adds power. Finish the Mossling with it.
lessons.hint_1: Overcharge spends all spare Energy. The more is left, the harder it hits.

lessons.name: Bond lesson: Weaken
lessons.text: A wild Spirling hears your call best when it is worn out. Wear this Mossling down, but don't knock it out.
lessons.hint_1: Updraft hits too hard at the end. A soft art leaves it standing.
lessons.hint_2: Two soft Draft Needles are enough.

lessons.name: Bond lesson: Status
lessons.text: A status makes the bond easier still. Leave Kindlop worn down and soaked.
lessons.hint_1: Drench soaks the foe. Fizz Pop wears it down.
lessons.hint_2: Fizz Pop, then Drench, then one more soft hit.
